deployable_probe_window_rule: Deployable probes may use windows 0..k-1 to act on window k and are scored on windows 1..K-1; every quantity they are compared against is restricted to the same windows.

headroom_definitions.baseline_loss: one primary foundation model, chosen once for the whole affected task set by its mean aggregate and applied unchanged to every task in it; not a per-task winner
headroom_definitions.oracle_loss: P0 per-origin minimum across the primary foundation models (uses evaluation labels; diagnostic only)
headroom_definitions.simple_loss: best deployable simple fix among P1, P3, P4 and P6
